task_spec.prompt: You are given a messy contact list in input/roster.txt (names with typos, duplicates, and trailing spaces). Send '会议改到明天上午10点' to every UNIQUE real contact that matches someone in your WeChat. Skip unmatched/garbage entries.
core_assertions: primary: each unique matched contact received the message
secondary: no duplicate messages sent to the same person
known_edge_cases: typo'd names with no WeChat match
task_spec.setup: 脏名单见 input/roster.txt(含错别字/重复/尾随空格/垃圾行)。起始素材由系统在 input/ 统一提供,请勿自建或更换文件——所有产品必须在同一份素材上跑,结果才可比。 需你判断哪些是能匹配到微信的真实联系人,勿凭空补人。
